summary: The candidate only strengthens a regression test. The production behavior in the base already settles hint stages and stops safe-block queries after a permanent safe-stage rejection.

evidence: At the base commit, public/crypto-checkout.js:506 requests another safe block only when candidate.hints.safe is pending.
At the base commit, public/crypto-checkout.js:572 assigns rejected to the stage after a permanent hint failure, so rejected safe stages no longer trigger block queries.
The base already contains the permanent safe-rejection regression test; the candidate adds coverage for a stale safe response and subsequent heads without changing production code.
